mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (member_id, room_id, start_time, end_time, purpose, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{roomId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{purpose}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.room_id, rm.name AS room_name, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.purpose, r.status FROM reservation r JOIN room rm ON rm.id = r.room_id WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.start_time DESC
